Honestly one of, if not the best 3rd person shooter I have played in a while.  To any fans of the Warhammer 40,000 (WH40K) universe this is the action game you have always wanted.  To all fans of the "Over powered super soldier in sapce"  Kneel before the first Space Marines.  the WH40k Space Marines are literaly demi-gods geneticly engeneered super soldiers made by the God Emporer of Mankind.  The game series has been around for 20+ years so technicly everyone else is copying them.  

This is the first real action game that holds decent weight to it and so it does take a lot of game play elements from other action games. At first glance that seems like ripping off Gears of War, but again WH40K is the great grand daddy of Gears...  That being said, the game is great.  The combat is bloody, fast, and very in your face.  Your armor is literaly covered in blood the more mele kills you perform, and you will do that a lot.  The visuals of the game perfectly represent the WH40K universe.  With the Vaulting Towers and foundries of an Imperial Forge world, Everything is in a hyper styalized Industrial Gothic scene.  The enemies are relentless.  Orks, in various forms and difficuties, Daemons with unholy speed and strength, and even worse Chaos Marines.  Once your brothers in arms, now they serve the dark forces of the Chaos gods...

PROs
--The graphics, its hard to over state just how good this game looks.
--Combat.  Glorius bloody combat.  In total there are 17* weapons to choose from all have thier own advantages and weakneses and fit different styles.
--The challenge, this game is hard.  WH40K is hard in general but this game tells you in the difficulty settings that you WILL die, even on easy.**
--Story line/plot.  Ill try not to post spoilers however, the story is pretty damned good.  Not the best litirary work ever but still holds it own.
--Multi-player, make your own Space Marine and Chaos Marine with near endless customization in looks.  Game modes are a bit sparce but its the classic deathmatch and Hoarde modes, as well as special DLC versions of each

*4 melee, 9 Ranged, 4 mounted Turret (these have limited ammo when removed from the turret mount)
**Remeber the Deamons I mentioned above?  They only use Melee attacks but they can teleport and on normal 3 of them can kill you in 5 seconds.  And they are some of the weaker enemies.

CONs
--Combat, Hard is fun, but this game is also unforgiving.  Ammo is spaced out regularly however you can only use each ammo box once, and they wont always fill all of your ammo reserves
--Healing, your shields regenerate if you dont get hit for a few seconds, your health can only regen if you perform a Melee execution, most enemies need to be stunned first, and the higher up enemies (garunteed 100% heal) need to take a lot of punishment before you can even stun them
--The game world/map  There is NO mini map, however the world is very linear, so transitioning from one area to the next is very dull, however these sections are often short and the figts and combat take place in large open areas
--Multi-player if you are a late comer of the game expect a lot of boots from online matches. and when you do get it, expect to be the cannon fodder.  I suggest leveling your online stats in the co-op maps first as those players are a bit more forgiving

Surprisingly solid. Makes you feel like the ultimate badass.

This game is one for all those familiar to the lore of Warhammer 40K and those looking for a viscereal experience. it has really rich environments with great detail being put into the levels. gameplay is good with seamless transition between melee and ranged.  

the storyline is decent and with several chapters to go through, you can easily spend 2 days on this.

multiplayer is one of challenging combat with the action being quite hectic in some of the smaller maps.

Exterminatus is my personal favourite - its a horde defense game whereby you and up to 3 other plays face off against waves of enemies.  it can get brutal in the later stages and requires good teamwork to even survive let alone hurt the enemy.

play this game if you like or have heard of WH40K, like pretty levels, intense combat or a challenging multiplayer.

A hack and slash treat with a typical WH40k story (i.e. lots of scenery chewing but in an awesome tongue in cheek over the top way). The game looks decent enough, features a strong voice cast and the gameplay is solid. If you are a fan of games such as Darksiders or a WH40k fan then you should get this. If you want to feel like a baddass Space Marine this game is for you, buy it now it's a little older for a very fun weekend! 8.5/10
